user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I need to send out SMS notifications to all the participants. Can you assist me with that? I also want to retrieve the list of phones registered to our Maytapi WhatsApp account to ensure all our team members are included. Furthermore, I need to check the SMSAPI.com profile to verify our payment type and available points.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the list of phones registered to our Maytapi WhatsApp account.
Check the SMSAPI.com profile to verify our payment type and available points.
Send out SMS notifications to all participants using the retrieved phone numbers.
